ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   C. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   D. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting
